issues.on_page: trimmed p1 is report p5; report p4 (Balance Sheet/Statement of Net Position) is not in the trimmed PDF
issues.issue: Balance sheet left null because the trim leaves out the statement. This is a trimming gap, not an extraction error. ending_cash is null for the same reason.

issues.on_page: CASH FLOWS FROM CAPITAL AND FINANCING ACTIVITIES: Net Transfers from Other Funds (58,088)
issues.issue: The section is headed 'capital and financing' and holds only an interfund transfer. Transfers normally count as noncapital financing, so this classification is a judgment call.

Treated as pro-rate motor vehicle (state aid); the same goes for detail[2] and detail[15] ('State Motor Vehicle Taxes', motor vehicle pro-rate). Defensible, but the label could also mean the county motor vehicle tax distribution (motor vehicle tax).

issues.on_page: Water Use Fees 90,554 (General Fund, budgetary basis; GAAP column '-')
issues.issue: Water utility revenue appears in the General Fund only on the budgetary basis, replacing the 58,088 transfer. It is entered as governmental detail while the same water revenue is business-type on p1, so governmental detail overstates governmental charges if aggregated.
